name: Reelsaw
description: Reelsaw is a self-hosted, AI-powered video clipper: paste a YouTube link or upload a video and it transcribes it, asks a language model for the most clippable moments, reframes the speaker into vertical 9:16 with face tracking, cuts fillers and burns in word-highlight captions. Open source (AGPL-3.0), any model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Groq, Deepgram, or a local Ollama and Whisper), and an MCP server so agents can drive it. Deploy it on Dokploy with Docker Compose and a Postgres database in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Self-hosted AI video clipper: long videos to vertical shorts with face-tracked reframing and word-highlight captions. Deploy Reelsaw with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, any AI provider.
